brief:
A Palestinian family now faces the loss of their home, part of a generational cycle of dispossession, Shehab Wire reported. Before asking who demolished their house after October 7, the family carried the memory of another home from which they were displaced in 1948.

Between the two dwellings, successive generations paid a price they did not choose. Their tragedy did not begin with a resistance decision.

title: Palestinian family's displacement predates October war by decades
